# Jingzao Image Forge

> A Codex visual-director Skill for structured AI image prompts, preventive clean GPT Image 2 rendering, dynamic semantic prompt budgets, cinematic film frames, continuous and layered UI Motion storyboards, character and prop consistency, real multi-image references, reference-image style learning, and cross-domain art direction. It compiles validated visual_generation_spec files for OpenAI GPT Image 2, FLUX, Midjourney, or generic image generators without truncating explicit fields. Its adaptive clean base lowers unowned speckle, texture noise, dirty AO, global oily/plastic response, and equal-detail risk while preserving intentional grain, brushwork, patina, wear, wetness, and optical artifacts.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/papperrollinggery/jingzao-image-forge
English documentation: https://github.com/papperrollinggery/jingzao-image-forge/blob/main/README.md
Chinese documentation: https://github.com/papperrollinggery/jingzao-image-forge/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md
Skill entrypoint: https://github.com/papperrollinggery/jingzao-image-forge/blob/main/SKILL.md

## Primary capabilities

- create: create a new image prompt from a brief
- progressive detail: keep the empty template neutral; apply only a medium-preserving clean base after real generation content exists; compile explicit professional controls when the task requires them
- reconstruct: describe observable reference-image attributes without claiming to recover a hidden prompt
- edit: describe the smallest local change and explicit preservation constraints
- restyle: change visual treatment while locking identity, pose, geometry, layout, and text
- expand: attempt canvas extension under a preservation contract; strict position/scale/ratio retention requires visual review and may fail
- learn_style: inspect actual reference images, separate observed/inferred/unknown traits, and export a source-image-free capsule with required transfer boundaries and advisory content-risk warnings
- styleboard: build cinematic or UI Motion boards with role-scoped references, exact in-frame text, local interface states, semantic accent ownership, optional L0-L3 hierarchy profiles, continuity locks, and direct-sheet, independent-frame, or hybrid generation
- creative routing: choose one primary scenario, genre family, aesthetic family, capture/render method, and up to three scene archetypes across 20+ use cases
- visual style atlas: cinematic naturalism, noir, expressionism, oneiric, sublime, graphic modernism, analog, editorial, handcrafted, painterly, animation, documentary, speculative, minimal, archival, and mixed media
- style authority and spatial tension: preserve explicit tone locks across scenarios; design dominant read, action/counterforce, foreground-midground-background roles, exaggeration, distortion, parallax, and motion evidence
- professional color pipeline: exposure, tone scale, black/white points, highlight rolloff, color separation, skin protection, film/print character, grain, halation, bloom, and shot matching
- professional render pipeline: Blender/Unreal/production-renderer appearance references, path/ray tracing, global illumination, PBR/NPR materials, volume, sampling, and visible pass separation inside one generated image
- verified multi-image delivery: emit actual supplied images, a target-aware Codex ImageGen call plan, fail-closed capability checks, and an expected-vs-sent execution receipt; never replace references with prose-only summaries or add post-generation compositing
- knowledge-aware generation: preserve exact named entities as optional knowledge_anchors
- artifact and material quality: use an automatic preventive clean base, optional `clean_reset`, low-frequency shape groups, explicit texture ownership, material-specific roughness/highlights, localized AO/contact, and a two-scale visual gate for oily or waxy sheen, random speckles, texture noise, dirty AO halos, plastic reflections, noisy darks, and equal-detail rendering
- dynamic prompt budget: classify concise/standard/complex/sequence/analysis prompts, derive CJK-aware review targets from duplicate-resistant semantic signals, expose platform review ranges, and never auto-truncate source fields
- surface-risk review: flag generic detail/gloss/lighting spells outside exact visible copy and return concrete positive rewrites
- bundled prompt-contamination guard: source trace, clean-slate reset, semantic ownership and deduplication, deletion test, stateless-generator read, and PASS/FAIL without requiring another installed Skill
- automatic visual direction: distinguish narrative film frames, key art, posters, grounded cinema, heightened cinema, graphic stylization, spectacle scale, camera freedom, and genre logic
- cinematic shot design: bind relationship, staging, viewer position, camera height, distance, focal length, focus, and motivated lighting
- causal VFX: define source, trigger, material/shape, path, operation, response, intensity, decay, and residue for Chinese fantasy, giant-scale, transformation, and destruction effects
- cross-platform compilation: OpenAI, FLUX, Midjourney, and generic targets

## Core files

- SKILL.md: discovery metadata, workflow, boundaries, and improvement protocol
- references/visual-spec.md: visual_generation_spec schema and control semantics
- references/prompt-compiler.md: platform-aware compilation, adaptive clean base, dynamic semantic review budget, and surface-risk behavior
- references/prompt-hygiene.md: bundled standalone source tracing, contamination classes, semantic ownership ledger, deletion test, stateless-generator read, feasibility, and style-preserving PASS/FAIL review
- references/quality-controls.md: artifact budgets, clean-surface reset, texture ownership, material-light controls, two-scale acceptance, and single-variable retry guidance
- Quality recovery uses evidence-bound source/region diagnosis, medium-preserving wording, clean-master selection and bounded retries; structural proxies are conditional, never a default or pixel-fidelity guarantee.
- references/cinematic-shot-design.md: narrative film-frame contracts, blocking, camera/lens coupling, and posterization guard
- references/direction-profiles.md: grounded, heightened, graphic, giant-scale, and Chinese-fantasy routing
- references/scenario-profiles.md: story, commercial, product, fashion, food, architecture, environment, knowledge, interface, game, event, social, and experimental routes
- references/visual-style-atlas.md: coherent aesthetic families, capture/render methods, style-mix rules, and failure guards
- references/shot-tension-design.md: beautiful-shot mechanisms, action/counterforce, depth-layer roles, camera distortion, exaggeration, and readability
- references/color-pipeline.md: professional grading, display intent, film finishing, grain, halation, tone scale, and sequence continuity
- references/render-pipeline.md: Blender/Unreal/renderer vocabulary, light transport, GI, PBR materials, sampling, passes, and artifacts
- references/reference-delivery.md: minimal actual-image source/role/must-attach records, ImageGen handoff, preflight, and no-compositing boundary
- references/reference-modes.md: reconstruct observed/inferred/unknown contract, restyle invariants, expand boundary continuity, and provider routing
- references/style-learning.md: reference-image observation, source-image-free capsule export, content-risk review, cross-subject tests, and adoption gates
- references/style-capsules.md: reviewed built-in capsule registry, transfer boundaries, evidence, and usage
- references/style-capsules/crimson-nocturne-wuxia-montage.json: adopted vertical crimson/cyan analog photomontage capsule learned from three user references without storing raw images
- references/styleboard-mode.md: reference roles, line-art/hand-drawn/cinematic presentation, frame cards, and 3x3 assembly
- references/ui-motion-storyboard.md: interface-state sequencing, exact typography, semantic accent ownership, local UI beats, and source/iteration archive
- templates/visual-spec.json: reusable JSON visual specification template
- templates/style-capsule.json: reusable source-image-free learned-style template
- scripts/validate_spec.py: standard-library specification validator
- scripts/validate_style_capsule.py: standard-library learned-style capsule validator
- scripts/reference_delivery.py: standard-library attachment manifest, Codex ImageGen capability preflight, call plan, and execution receipt verification
- scripts/prompt_lint.py: deterministic compiled-prompt leakage and fixture-ceiling checks
- scripts/validate_forward_tests.py: validates forward-test evidence paths and prompt hashes without pixel regression
- scripts/create_style_capsule.py: deterministic source-image-free capsule exporter with advisory content-risk warnings
- scripts/compile_prompt.py: standard-library prompt compiler
- scripts/compile_production.py: opt-in shot-coverage validation and isolated single-frame compilation; no image or video execution
- references/production-coverage.md: risk-based image anchors, world-space reverse views, prop states, edit side effects, and upstream workflow boundary
- examples/production-coverage.json: original front/reverse/insert image specs plus a justified video-only beat
- examples/atomic-cyber-live-action.json: synthetic validated edit example
- examples/narrative-film-frame.json: validated relationship-driven cinematic ultrawide example
- examples/styleboard-3x3.json: validated reference-led hybrid nine-grid storyboard example
- examples/ui-motion-storyboard.json: validated four-frame independent 16:9 UI Motion line-art sequence with exact Chinese text, layered editorial L0-L3 hierarchy, calm zones, and one semantic accent
- examples/continuous-nine-shot-ferry.json: validated live-action direct-sheet specification for nine causal shots with identity, wardrobe, prop, geography, light, screen-direction, and object-state continuity
- examples/jingzao-intro-infographic-edit.json: validated source-matched product-introduction edit specification; its first ImageGen candidate failed the embedded-board preservation gate and was rejected
- examples/style-learning-graphite-copper.json: validated reference-image style-learning record based on an inspected Jingzao-owned asset
- examples/style-capsule-graphite-copper.json: validated reusable style capsule with no embedded source image
- examples/tactile-stop-motion-product.json: validated handcrafted product scenario
- examples/architecture-exhibition.json: validated architectural-spatial scenario
- examples/causal-fantasy-effect.json: validated battle-tension, causal VFX, professional color, advanced materials, and Blender Cycles appearance-reference example
- examples/reconstruct-architecture-reference.json: reconstruct contract with observed/inferred/unknown separation
- examples/restyle-risograph-editorial.json: restyle contract with locked source geometry and one treatment change
- examples/expand-roadside-outpaint.json: expand contract with source-bound continuity and crop-safe new edges
- tests/test_skill.py: deterministic regression tests
- tests/evals.md: behavioral evaluation cases
- tests/benchmark-results.md: same-model qualitative prompt-strategy benchmark and evidence-backed conclusions
- tests/forward-test-manifest.json: traceable prompt hashes, approved outputs, scenarios, and visual review records
- assets/jingzao-image-forge-hero-en.png: English visual introduction page generated with Codex imagegen
- assets/jingzao-image-forge-hero-zh.png: Chinese visual introduction page generated with Codex imagegen
- assets/jingzao-image-forge-group-card-zh.png: concise Chinese community recommendation card
- assets/jingzao-image-forge-group-card-zh-v2.png: information-rich Chinese workflow, capabilities, and use-case recommendation card
- assets/jingzao-image-forge-intro-zh-v5.png: current accepted landscape product introduction page; the later edit-mode candidate was rejected because it redrew the embedded evidence board
- assets/jingzao-image-forge-intro-zh-v4.png: previous landscape workflow page showing reference preflight, call planning, ImageGen, receipt, and visual review
- assets/jingzao-image-forge-recommendation-zh-v3.png: current vertical feature recommendation poster
- assets/jingzao-image-forge-wechat-card-zh-v3.png: current concise WeChat group recommendation card
- assets/gallery/: fifteen web-optimized, visually inspected outputs spanning continuous cinematic storyboards, narrative film, causal fantasy, hand-drawn nine-grid, material realism, product, architecture, restyle, reconstruction, CG fashion, path-traced object design, and cross-subject style-capsule transfers; twelve are manifest-bound and three are explicitly manual-review-only

## Invocation

$jingzao-image-forge <image brief, reference observation, or edit request>

## Important boundaries

- The Skill prepares specifications and prompts; it does not generate images by itself.
- Coordinates are semantic anchors, not pixel-accurate masks.
- Model world knowledge is a creative aid, not verification evidence.
- Provider capabilities and parameters must be rechecked against current official documentation before they are changed or promised.
- Generated images must be visually inspected before claiming quality, identity accuracy, or edit success.
- Runtime scripts require Python 3.10+ and have no third-party runtime dependency.

## Validation

python3 scripts/validate_spec.py templates/visual-spec.json
python3 scripts/validate_spec.py examples/atomic-cyber-live-action.json
python3 scripts/validate_spec.py examples/ui-motion-storyboard.json
python3 scripts/validate_spec.py examples/continuous-nine-shot-ferry.json
python3 scripts/validate_spec.py examples/jingzao-intro-infographic-edit.json
python3 scripts/validate_spec.py examples/style-learning-graphite-copper.json
python3 scripts/compile_production.py examples/production-coverage.json --platform openai
python3 scripts/validate_style_capsule.py examples/style-capsule-graphite-copper.json
python3 scripts/validate_style_capsule.py references/style-capsules/crimson-nocturne-wuxia-montage.json
python3 scripts/validate_forward_tests.py tests/forward-test-manifest.json
python3 scripts/prompt_lint.py examples/causal-fantasy-effect.json --platform openai --max-words 1800
uvx ruff check scripts tests
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

Current deterministic baseline: 205 regression tests covering schema, compilation, four-platform UI Motion exact-text/accent/sequence/L0-L3 hierarchy behavior, hierarchy-profile type safety and required-field validation, duplicate-resistant hierarchy-aware complexity signals, empty/constraints-only fail-closed behavior, four-platform adaptive clean_base and explicit-budget replacement, CJK-aware dynamic semantic review targets, duplicate-resistant complexity signals/modes, platform review caps without truncation, exact-copy-safe English/Chinese surface-risk review, clean_reset recovery, target-aware handoff/receipt, recursive public-receipt sanitization, repository path confinement, manifest/case/prompt-source allowlists, committed-output hashes, executable prompt review, four-platform source-structured contamination lint, no-deletion projection of explicit professional controls, evidence bindings, and CLI contracts. Generated-image quality is a manual forward-test gate, not a pixel CI claim.
Manifest-bound outputs and three explicitly manual-review-only examples are committed under assets/gallery; failed and superseded candidates remain ignored.
